title: feat(video): add Kandinsky 6.0 Lite via fal
author: fisventurous

gist.summary: Added Kandinsky 6.0 Lite (`kandinskylab/kandinsky-6.0-lite`) via fal for paid-only, 5-second 480p video generation with synchronized audio from text or one start image. Pricing is per video, with separate rates for text and start-image requests; Quest-only wallets receive a 402 response. Billing uses fal-reported billable units, and reconnecting to a disconnected request or repeating a cached request does not create another generation or debit. Added the model to the registry and model information with a Kandinsky logo. Local checks observed roughly 200 seconds per video.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny director’s beret and watches a retro screen turn a painted start frame into a short filmstrip with little music notes; a lime green (#ecf874) glow lights the flowers and code-plants. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
